title: Tell us your idea
subtitle: Speak or type. You can edit the words before we read them.
chatSubtitle: Answer what you know. You can change everything on the next screen.
transcriptPlaceholder: e.g. I want to start a home bakery in Pune, making cakes from my kitchen.
privacyNote: Please do not share ID numbers, bank details or phone numbers.
skip: Skip questions and see my profile
unsupported: We support home food, tailoring/boutique and online reselling for now. Which is closest to your idea?

voice.hint: Tap the mic and speak, or type below.
voice.listening: Listening… tap again when you finish.
voice.recording: Recording (up to 60 seconds)… tap to stop.

errors.denied: The microphone is blocked. Please allow it in your browser, or just type your idea below.
errors.offline: No internet connection. Check it and try again, or type your idea below.
errors.nothing: We did not hear anything. Try again closer to the phone, or type below.
errors.noMic: No microphone found. Please type your idea below.
errors.unsupported: Voice is not available in this browser. Please type your idea below.
errors.failed: Voice did not work this time. Please try again or type below.

errors.empty: Please write a few words first.
errors.ai: We could not understand that just now. Please try again, or skip and fill the profile card yourself.
